title: Data Analyst Consultant - DSNY10
description:
**_APPLICATIONS ARE NOT CONSIDERED WITHOUT A Tableau Public visualization. Before applying to this role, please familiarize yourself with our [aptitude-based selection process](https://www.thedataschool.com/apply/)._**

**Data Analyst Consultant – DSNY10 (August 4, 2025)**
 **Location** New York City
 **Organization** The Data School US
 **Contract Type** 2.5 years fixed term
 **Work Environment** On-site
 **Final Application Deadline** June 11, 2025
 **Early Feedback Deadline** Submit by May 30 to receive feedback on your application
The Information Lab has a simple mission which is to help people make sense of data. We believe that companies that use data well will have better futures than those that do not. We have helped clients such as The Vanguard Group, JPMorgan Chase, PwC, JLL, and Paramount Global through our specialization in and consulting on the leading products for data visualization and data integration—Tableau and Alteryx—since 2011.
As a consultant in The Data School program, you will experience immersive and rewarding on-the-job training unlike traditional roles. This is a 28-month contract in which we pay you to learn about data and technology from some of the greatest data experts in the world, including six Tableau Visionaries and three Alteryx ACEs.
Training will take place over four months at our facility located on Union Square. Following training, you will apply your new knowledge and skills through placements with major blue-chip clients across the US.
The training goes beyond technical learning. With support from your coaches and the wider team, you will build personal skills in storing, managing, and presenting data, and you will develop confidence to become an exceptional consultant. We teach in an inclusive, collaborative environment where everyone's growth and success is supported by the group.
Our training and consulting are focused on Tableau and Alteryx. No coding experience is necessary to excel. Many of our consultants had never heard of Tableau before finding us. What they share is a passion for solving problems with data. If you are inquisitive and driven to uncover the truth through evidence, The Data School could be the perfect next chapter in your career.
We welcome everyone at The Information Lab and The Data School regardless of background, education, appearance, or personal interests. We value diversity because it helps uncover new stories in data and generates unexpected solutions to complex challenges.
To apply, we ask you to create a dashboard with a dataset of your choice. Details are at [www.thedataschool.com/apply](http://www.thedataschool.com/apply) or see below for a summary.
**You might be a good fit if you are**
- Comfortable working with numbers
- Analytical
- Data-driven
- A people person
- A problem solver
- A confident communicator
**Job details**
- Location is Civic Hall, 124 E 14th St, New York, NY 10003
- Contract is 28-month fixed term
- Salary is $65,000 per year
- Benefits include 25 days paid time off per year, health insurance, 401k with 4 percent match, laptop, and mobile phone
- Calendar year salary increases
- US work authorization required (non-student or STEM OPT). We use E-Verify to validate employment eligibility
- In-person role during training with hybrid schedule potential afterward
**Application process**
- Find a dataset that interests you. Your interest will improve your results
- Download Tableau Public or apply for a Tableau Student Licence if you are in full-time education
- Sign up and create a Tableau Public profile
- Publish your dashboard to your Tableau Public profile
- Complete the application form and include your dashboard URL
- Submit your first draft well ahead of the deadline to allow time for feedback and iteration
**Suggested data sources include**
- Makeover Monday
- Kaggle
- Data Commons
- NYC Open Data
We encourage applications from all academic backgrounds and welcome career changers. We do not discriminate on gender, ethnicity, race, or sexual orientation.
